result.rationale: Adult with low-energy ankle inversion injury, mild lateral soreness, small swelling, no deformity, numbness, wound, or bony tenderness at malleoli or midfoot; no emergency features reported. Weight-bearing status is unknown (not negative), so guidance should include home care (protection, rest, ice, compression, elevation) and clear instructions to seek in-person assessment if unable to take four steps, or if pain/swelling worsens, numbness, or inability to improve develops.
